import openai

# Assume you have your OpenAI API key set as an environment variable
# For a real-world application, you would handle API keys securely.
# Example: os.environ['OPENAI_API_KEY'] = 'YOUR_API_KEY'

def generate_email_content(prompt, model="gpt-3.5-turbo", max_tokens=150, temperature=0.7):
    """Generates email content using the OpenAI API."""
    try:
        response = openai.ChatCompletion.create(
            model=model,
            messages=[
                {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant that writes emails."},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt}
            ],
            max_tokens=max_tokens,
            temperature=temperature
        )
        return response.choices[0].message['content'].strip()
    except Exception as e:
        return f"An error occurred during content generation: {e}"

def draft_personalized_welcome_email():
    """Drafths a welcome email for a new subscriber."""
    subject_prompt = "Suggest a subject line for a welcome email to a new subscriber."
    subject = generate_email_content(subject_prompt)
    if subject.startswith("An error"):
        subject = "Welcome to Our Newsletter!" # Fallback subject

    body_prompt = f"Write a friendly and engaging welcome email body. The subject is '{subject}'. Congratulate the new subscriber on joining and briefly mention what they can expect. Keep it concise and inviting. Do not mention it is AI-generated."
    body = generate_email_content(body_prompt)
    if body.startswith("An error"):
        body = "We're thrilled to have you on board! Get ready for exciting updates, exclusive content, and special offers delivered straight to your inbox." # Fallback body

    return f"Subject: {subject}\n\n{body}"

def draft_follow_up_email(customer_name, product_interest):
    """Drafts a follow-up email based on customer interest."""
    subject_prompt = f"Suggest a follow-up email subject for {customer_name} who is interested in {product_interest}."
    subject = generate_email_content(subject_prompt)
    if subject.startswith("An error"):
        subject = f"Following Up on Your Interest in {product_interest}" # Fallback subject

    body_prompt = f"Write a personalized follow-up email to {customer_name} who has shown interest in {product_interest}. Offer more information or a helpful resource related to it. Maintain a casual yet professional tone. Do not mention it is AI-generated."
    body = generate_email_content(body_prompt)
    if body.startswith("An error"):
        body = f"We noticed you were interested in {product_interest}! We wanted to share a helpful guide that dives deeper into its benefits and features. You can find it here: [Link to Resource]. Let us know if you have any questions!" # Fallback body

    return f"Subject: {subject}\n\n{body}"

# --- Example Usage ---

print("--- Drafting a Welcome Email ---")
welcome_email = draft_personalized_welcome_email()
